### One with His People
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/one-his-people
Passage: Matthew 3:13-17
Points:
- John hesitates to baptize Jesus, recognizing the Savior has no personal sin to confess.
- Jesus receives baptism to fulfill all righteousness through total obedience to the Father's saving plan.
- Where Israel and earthly Davidic kings failed, Jesus stands as God's faithful Son and servant.
- By entering the water, Christ deliberately identifies Himself with the plight of His people.
- Believers can draw daily comfort knowing Jesus stepped down into our world and understands our trials.

### Day 96: Matthew 3:13–15
Author: Beth Moore
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/plus/books/portraits-of-devotion/portraits-of-devotion-day-96-matthew-3-1315.html
Passage: Matthew 3:13-15
Points:
- God orchestrated the ministries of John and Jesus to meet at the Jordan River.
- John felt stunned and deeply unworthy when the Messiah asked to be baptized by him.
- Jesus submitted to baptism to fulfill all righteousness and launch His public ministry.
- Unlike the confessing crowds, the sinless Christ required no repentance and received the Father's blessing.
- Yielding our lives entirely to God enables Him to accomplish extraordinary things through us.
